description: Selected offline gun profile for AK47 and laser SMG; enter these four settings in Aim Bot. Existing saved values are never overwritten automatically.
limitations: Synthetic trajectories, not measured server hits.
No obstacle collision, spread, muzzle offsets or unknown server timing.
No universally best profile across all weapons, ping and future target turns.
Selection, visuals, spear and Jitter controls are checked separately; they are not optimized by this gun-only score.
